Ruoyi

Undergraduate student · University of Waterloo

I am interested in software engineering, developer tools, and research on how software is created, reused, and maintained. I enjoy building practical tools and using what I learn from them to ask more careful questions.

About

I am an undergraduate student at the University of Waterloo. My recent work combines web development with an interest in empirical software research. I am currently exploring research opportunities and continuing to build a foundation in computer science and mathematics.

Research interests

I am particularly interested in AI agent skills as a new kind of software artifact. Questions I am exploring include:

  • How can we study the reuse and evolution of agent skills across repositories?
  • What evidence can distinguish similar content from a likely history of copying?
  • Which measurable signals can help evaluate the quality or usefulness of a skill?

These are current interests and questions, rather than published research results.
